title: TNW RSS Article
description: A news article as published in The Next Web RSS 2.0 feed.

link.description: Canonical URL to the full article on thenextweb.com.

description.description: Short summary or excerpt of the article content.

pubDate.description: Publication date and time in RFC 2822 format (e.g., Sat, 02 May 2026 17:09:00 +0000).

category.description: Category or categories the article belongs to (e.g., Artificial Intelligence, Startups, Cars).

guid.description: Globally unique identifier for the article, typically the article URL.

enclosure.description: Media enclosure attached to the item (typically a featured image).
